tasks.title: Single-flight Zoom token: mode-aware zoom_token(), persist rotated refresh token first, ZoomAuthError, per-mode scope check
tasks.notes: Research Q6, Finding 4, Step 3. Zoom allows one token pair per user+app and rotates refresh tokens (devforum 127541); refresh tokens expire after 90 days. OAuth mode: hold a threading.Lock AND an fcntl.flock on a lock file beside the connection DB (covers the separate python -m pipeline.collect CLI process; owner confirmed this approach 2026-09-21) across read refresh_token -> oauth_zoom.refresh -> connections.set_secret(new refresh_token) BEFORE returning/caching; cache the access token in-process until 5 min before expiry. invalid_grant -> ZoomAuthError (hard, 'sign in again', like GmailAuthError health.py:400). check_zoom() uses the same function (Test button never refreshes separately) and checks ZOOM_USER_SCOPES in oauth mode: meeting:read:list_summaries, meeting:read:summary, meeting:read:list_meetings, meeting:read:list_past_participants + cloud_recording:read:meeting_transcript whenever include_transcripts is true (default true). S2S mode likewise adds cloud_recording:read:meeting_transcript:admin to the required set when include_transcripts is true. S2S mode path unchanged. Required test: two threads call zoom_token() concurrently -> exactly one POST to zoom.us/oauth/token and the stored refresh_token is the newest.

tasks.title: Meetings collector: union of summaries, previous_meetings and (S2S) pastJoined report, with participants
tasks.notes: Research Q4 + Step 4. /users/me/meetings?type=previous_meetings (spec: scheduled only, no instant meetings); /report/users/{uid}/meetings?type=pastJoined only in S2S mode (report:read:user:admin; resolve uid via GET /users/me, reports may reject 'me'); summaries list catches instant meetings with a summary. Merge by meeting_uuid, one Item('meeting', uuid, occurred, payload) per meeting in window. Payload keys: topic, start_time, end_time, host_email, hosted (bool), participants[] (name/email, only for hosted meetings via GET /past_meetings/{uuid}/participants, double-encode UUID via encode_uuid), summary_content, summary_doc_url, summary_available. Keep existing behaviours: 404 summary -> summary_available False; partial status on per-meeting failures; SUMMARY_LOOKBACK. ZoomAuthError -> CollectionResult error with 'sign in again'. Mock only requests.

tasks.title: Opt-in transcripts: fetch /meetings/{uuid}/transcript and download text, capped, when include_transcripts
tasks.notes: Research Finding 6. On by default (owner decision 2026-09-21); include_transcripts=false turns it off. Only for hosted meetings. GET /meetings/{uuid}/transcript returns download_url, can_download, download_restriction_reason; download with Bearer token; cap text at TRANSCRIPT_MAX = 200_000 chars with a transcript_truncated flag; 404 or can_download false -> transcript_available False plus reason, never a failure. Transcripts need cloud recording per Zoom staff; do not treat absence as an error.
